name: @triliumnext/edit-docs
description: Desktop version of Trilium which imports the demo database (presented to new users at start-up) or the user guide and other documentation and saves the modifications for committing.

scripts.edit-docs: cross-env TRILIUM_PORT=37741 TRILIUM_DATA_DIR=data TRILIUM_INTEGRATION_TEST=memory-no-store tsx ../../scripts/electron-start.mts src/edit-docs.ts
scripts.sync-docs: cross-env TRILIUM_DATA_DIR=data TRILIUM_INTEGRATION_TEST=memory-no-store TRILIUM_ENV=dev TRILIUM_RESOURCE_DIR=../server/src tsx src/sync-docs.ts
scripts.edit-demo: cross-env TRILIUM_PORT=37744 TRILIUM_DATA_DIR=data TRILIUM_INTEGRATION_TEST=memory-no-store DOCS_ROOT=../../../docs tsx ../../scripts/electron-start.mts src/edit-demo.ts
